comment.body:
Thanks for the report. To investigate this further on a current build, could you please provide:
1. Exact numbered repro steps from a fresh PowerToys start on the latest version you can test.
2. A new PowerToys Report ZIP captured immediately after the failure.
3. Whether the issue persists after rebooting PowerToys and after updating/reinstalling the affected module.
4. Screenshots or a short recording if the problem is visual or depends on a specific window/app.
